source_title: Kerala teen stabs grandfather to death while trying to protect minor sister
source_excerpt: PALAKKAD: A 65-year-old man, who was allegedly stabbed by his grandson while trying to stop him from attacking his younger sister in Alathur, died while undergoing treatment at a hospital, police said on Saturday.According to news agency PTI, the deceased was identified as Sulaiman, a resident of Vazhakkachira in Kavaserry near Alathur.The incident took place at their house in Kavaserry on October 19, when the 16-year-old boy allegedly tried to attack his 10-year-old sister following an argument.Sulaiman suffered stab injuries to his chest, neck and abdomen while attempting to intervene and stop the attack, police said.Both were initially admitted to a private hospital in Alathur.However, as Sulaiman's condition was critical, he was shifted to the Thrissur Medical College Hospital for further treatment.He died late Friday night while undergoing treatment, police said. The girl has recovered from her injuries and is out of danger.The accused went into hiding after the incident but was later apprehended by police and sent to a juvenile home.Alathur police had initially registered a case of attempt to murder.
